text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's morning at Tracen Academy. The students put aside thoughts of running and pour their efforts into studying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Studyin' is boring as heck. I'd rather spend my time gettin' faster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Vodka, I expect you to take this seriously. This is one of our obligations as students.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: She's right, you know! I'm gonna study too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, I hear you, geez. Um, let's see what this question's about…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please fill the blank with the appropriate phrase. "Never put off until tomorrow…"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah, how're ya supposed to figure that out? Pass!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That one's so easy. "Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? That's boring. How 'bout I make my own saying?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Never put off until tomorrow—whatever, like I care. See? Easy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come on, guys. Aren't you forgetting the most important thing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sure, you can avoid putting things off, or not care at all. But beyond all that…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Never put off until tomorrow what you can enjoy today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Enjoy…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yup. Every day we chase bigger and better results. But in the middle of all that, we start to forget…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is to enjoy what every day brings. So when a study session gets you down, you gotta take a break!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Teio. You're just trying to wriggle your way out of studying, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urk! Well, what would you write?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My answer would be, "What you can do today has all been settled yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wow… I may be number one, but she's zero and center…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now we only have to wait to hear which of us gave the most exemplary answer.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: So, the student who gave the best answer is… Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-what did she write?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, my answer was, "Never put off until tomorrow…"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: What you're gonna do today!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, that's pretty good… I mean, it's simple, but still…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This can't be! You're telling us Turbo, with her sheer enthusiasm alone, penned the best saying?!
